text_block_list.text:
In anticipation of the Japanese Derby,
Symboli
Rudolf throws herself body and
soul into training,
but Эйр Грув worries
she's pushing herself too
hard.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She tries to shut Rudolf out of the
student council
office to relieve some of
the weight from her
shoulders, but
Rudolf seems dissatisfied.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
While Симболи Рудольф understands Air
Groove's
feelings, as both the president
and the Emperor,
she cannot stop.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
